programme.notes: Programme page as recorded in kb_imported_dev.json (not re-researched in this top-up).

english.quote: The German C1 language certificate must be submitted by the application deadline (=31 March) at the latest.
english.notes: University-wide for all Bachelor's programmes: 'The main teaching language during Bachelor's degree studies is German.' No English test applies; German C1 certificate (list of recognised certificates and waivers on the same page) by 31 March.

gpa.notes: No grade minimum published by ETH: admission with a non-Swiss certificate is country- and certificate-specific (without exam, reduced or comprehensive entrance examination), per swissuniversities and the ETH country list PDF (https://ethz.ch/content/dam/ethz/main/education/admission/bachelor/andere-qual/ETH-ZulassungsbedingungenHS2026_EN.pdf, autumn 2026). Admission-prerequisites page: 'We can only ascertain whether you need to sit an ETH entrance examination (reduced or comprehensive) after receiving your complete application'.

deadline.quote: Application period for applicants with non-Swiss upper secondary school-leaving certificates: from 1 December to 31 March, 23:59 Central European Time
deadline.notes: Year not printed; Bachelor studies start only in the Autumn Semester, so the 1 December 2026 - 31 March 2027 window is for autumn 2027 entry. German language certificate also due 31 March. One Bachelor programme per application.

value.population: foreign students who do not meet the simple-fee criteria (fee group 2)

tuition.notes: Regulation in effect since autumn semester 2025: simple fee CHF 730/semester for Swiss/Liechtenstein citizens and those resident in CH/FL when obtaining their entrance qualification, and certain EU/EFTA permit holders; all others pay the threefold fee. Study fees 'include the tuition and the semester fees'. Not multiplied to a year.
